name: Southwest Airlines
outlook:
What Southwest Airlines says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: unit revenueFourth quarter 2026 RASM is expected to increase between 19% and 21% year-over-year
  • Fourth quarter 2026: unit costs excluding fuelFourth quarter 2026 CASM-X 1,2 is expected to increase between 4.0% and 4.5% year-over-year, which includes an expected 1.0 point headwind from the removal of six seats from the Boeing 737-700 fleet to enable extra legroom seating
  • Full year 2026: capacityEntered 2026 with a disciplined capacity plan and now expect full-year growth of approximately 1.2%, versus last updated guidance of approximately 1.5%
  • Full year 2026: net capital spendingExpect 2026 net capital spending 4 between $2.5 billion and $2.75 billion
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
